description:
The Developer Publications Content Engineering team is responsible for creating world-class developer tools for the documentation workflows in Xcode and Appleʼs developer website. We are looking for a an experienced full stack software engineer to help scale and improve our existing technology, while also innovating on new products, infrastructure, and tooling.

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical foundation, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment. They will also be experienced in front end and back end technologies, such as HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, databases, API design, and architecting reliable systems. As a member of the team, you will work alongside a small, geographically distributed but impactful team, enable cross functional collaboration with other departments at Apple, mentor other engineers, and contribute to architecture discussions, code reviews, and proposals.

Description
This is your opportunity to join a highly motivated team who value collaboration and is committed to building reliable publication systems. We are passionate about the products we build and are dedicated to delivering high-performance software that exceeds our customersʼ expectations. In this role, you will: 


* Collaborate closely with software developers, designers, technical writers and program managers to define and scope user needs
* Model great software engineering practices by producing well tested, performant and reliable code to the multiple systems we maintain
* Participate in the team culture and engage in code review, pair programming and architecture discussions with other members of the team
* Constantly seek areas of improvement

Minimum qualifications
Years of experience: 4+
Proficient in Javascript frameworks, REST frameworks and APIs, relational databases, and similar technologies
Excellent understanding of the software development lifecycle 
Experience shipping high quality, performant and reliable products and features
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, understand needs, and define test strategies
Excellent communication, problem solving, and critical thinking skills
BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering (or equivalent experience)

Preferred qualifications
Proficient with web front end technologies such as Vue.js, React, HTML5, and CSS3
Familiarity with APIs and best practices for integrating with backend services
Experience with containerized applications, continuous integration and delivery, and test driven development
all_locations: San Diego, United States of America
